name: Global Plates
summary: Global Plates is a single-player factory-automation puzzle game about cooking. Players build conveyor-belt kitchens with dispensers, processors and assemblers to prepare dishes from around the world. Food loses freshness over time, so short, efficient production lines score better. Each level ends with a café service day in which cat customers pay coins and tips based on how fresh their plates are, and coins are spent on upgrades. A free demo with four levels is available on Steam.
